title: Make Dashboard current-state interaction trustworthy
scope: Preserve in-progress Agent Command input across unrelated live refreshes and make current, approval, QA, stale, and attention states truthful and discoverable before terminal history.
acceptance_criteria: Unrelated SSE refreshes preserve dirty instruction text, selection, and focus; target-state changes invalidate confirmation visibly without silently discarding the draft.

Dashboard metrics and attention surfaces agree with canonical status, repository-origin timeline events are not duplicated as fresh observations, and current work appears before terminal history at desktop and 420px.
overlap_resolution: WI-0029 and WI-0030 retain Agent Command release authority; WI-0033 owns provider trust sections and remains out of Build; WI-0034 owns only review-found Dashboard state preservation, attention, ordering, freshness, accessibility, and timeline correction.
